items.name: Scrambled eggs
items.preparation: scrambled, probably cooked with a little butter or oil

items.name: Cooking oil in the greens
items.preparation: implied by the sautéed greens' glossy look

scale_cues: Square white dinner plate about 25-27 cm across, filling most of the frame on a tray. Each portion's size was judged by how much of the plate it covers and how thick it looks.
assumptions: I read the dark reddish-brown strips as smoked brisket. They could instead be thick bacon, pastrami or steak, which would change the calories noticeably.
The scrambled eggs are about 3 large eggs with some butter or milk, at about 1.5 kcal per gram.
The greens look like spinach or kale sautéed with about 1 teaspoon of oil.
There are no drinks or sauces in the image.
